## e9e7805b09dd

**Status: reproduced defects; source left unchanged.** Generator version `2.1.0`, SHA-256 `8196041704b08832c77113bf7d7df434835c1d70ff623ce750e697896f8adf25`; canonical rule hash `af9dc25ea27e`.

### A3 — The default domain cannot reproduce the canonical 10×10 lesson profile

All 8 canonical inputs are 10×10 and use 2×2 multicolour blocks. The generator declares minimum dimensions 12×12 and its difficulty-specific defaults begin at 12 or 14. The strict profile probe sampled 60 inputs—20 per band—and observed 0 exact canonical-profile hits and 0 canonical-envelope hits. A second deterministic 60-draw probe, seed `9000+i`, sample index `i`, likewise found 0 10×10 inputs.

This is not merely extra diversity: a Qwen learner never sees the compact canonical spatial regime in which extensions from multiple 2×2 objects can approach one another. Evidence: `checks/audit/e9e7805b09dd/profile2/checks/e9e7805b09dd_before_profile_floor.json` and `checks/audit/e9e7805b09dd/counterexample.json`.

### A4 — Two advertised exact controls are dead, unknown controls are accepted, and declared domains disagree with per-band behavior

At seed `271828`, sample index `11`, medium difficulty with fixed 14×14/two-object settings, toggling `anchor_corner` false→true leaves the grid byte-identical; toggling `asymmetry_force` false→true also leaves it byte-identical. The shared SHA-256 is `56e926da36638dc1b2bfb6f27c6430c366d4af92c2c5aed374939ee7dd9f2049`. An unknown override is silently accepted with the same output.

The axis table says `grid_h/grid_w` are valid over 12..22 and `n_objs` over 1..4, yet medium generation rejects `grid_h`/`grid_w` values 12 and 22 and rejects `n_objs` values 1 and 4 before the later clamping code can run. The generated witness passes `self_check`, and canonical Racket application produces a valid output, so the dead controls are directly reproducible on a lawful input.

Racket-bound reproducer: `checks/audit/e9e7805b09dd/input.json`, `checks/audit/e9e7805b09dd/racket.json`, and compact `checks/audit/e9e7805b09dd/counterexample.json`.

**Suggested repair, not applied.** Add an exact 10×10/2×2 canonical branch; either implement `anchor_corner` and `asymmetry_force` observably or remove them; validate unknown keys; and make declared domains difficulty-aware or honor the full advertised domain.
